observation.visible_scene: A close, eye-level shot of deep-frying in progress. A black long-handled wok sits over an open gas flame; its contents are submerged in vigorously bubbling hot oil, with a reddish triangular piece on the right and pale strips/legs toward the top. Steam/smoke rises from the wok and from a metal pot at the right edge. A person in a red apron is partly visible at the left (arm and torso), and a wooden-handled metal ladle rests on the stove in the lower foreground. The framing stays largely stable across the excerpt.
visible_changes: The oil keeps boiling vigorously throughout, with the bubble pattern constantly churning and reshaping.
The fried pieces bob and drift slightly within the bubbling oil (e.g., the reddish piece shifts a little leftward over time), consistent with agitation from the boiling rather than a new action.
The flames around and behind the wok flicker and change shape/intensity frame to frame, sometimes licking higher up the left or right rim and sometimes flaring tall behind the wok.
The rising steam/smoke plumes vary in density and position, especially over the right-hand pot.
The person's arm/hand at the left moves slightly but remains in roughly the same area; no cooking tool is seen being used on the wok.
There may be a very slight overall drift of the framing (wok handle and foreground ladle shift a few pixels), but background evidence is too dark to confirm camera motion versus a small wok movement.
outside_clip_unknowns: What exactly is being fried and the recipe/steps before or after this segment.
Whether the cook will stir, flip, or remove the food, or how long frying continues.
The cause of the flame variations (gas adjustment vs. natural flicker).
uncertain_details: Identity of the food pieces (meat/seafood not confirmable).
Whether the small positional changes of the wok/ladle are camera drift or the cook moving the pan.
Whether the food's slight movement is from boiling agitation or any unseen stirring.
